disclaimers_items.label: Report Accuracy:
disclaimers_items.text: This analysis is based on the credit-report information supplied for this assessment. Please verify every figure and account detail against the original credit report. Credit information is dynamic and changes frequently. Scores and recommendations may change based on new account information.

disclaimers_items.label: Professional Opinion:
disclaimers_items.text: This AI-assisted analysis is for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute financial, legal, or lending advice. Consult with qualified financial advisors before making major financial decisions.

disclaimers_items.label: Lender Variability:
disclaimers_items.text: Different lenders use different criteria, scoring models, and risk parameters. Approval decisions vary by lender and loan type.

disclaimers_items.label: Score Interpretation:
disclaimers_items.text: Credit scores are one factor in lending decisions. Lenders also consider income, employment, collateral, existing relationships, and economic conditions.

disclaimers_items.label: Legal Rights:
disclaimers_items.text: You have the right to dispute any information in your credit report. Contact CIBIL directly for corrections: www.cibil.com
